scope: Observation geometry from the sixteen original baseline views

coordinates.normalizedBoxDecimal: Exact stored decimal values as strings. Order xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax. Vision origin bottom left of the observed view.
coordinates.pixelEnclosure: Order left, top, right, bottom. Top-left origin, half-open integer bounds, rounded outward.
coordinates.viewToUpright: For horizontal-mirror views, [1-xmax, ymin, 1-xmin, ymax]. Normal views use identity.
coordinates.meaning: Original detector rectangles and their whole-pixel enclosures.
